status_note: Third V3 iteration -- completes the epoch sweep (1/2/3). Corpus held at n=100 (same 2691-record fuzzy-gate corpus as iter 2, no new generation) but epochs cut 2->1 (NUM_EPOCHS=1, 1346 total steps) to test the low end of the total-training-steps axis. Negative result vs iter 2 but informative: field F1 0.6597 (72-rec) vs iter 2's 0.6745 and iter 1's 0.6581 -- one epoch underfits and missing_field's share of failures rose back to 57.0% (196/344). The sweep brackets the optimum: 1ep 0.6597 / 2ep 0.6745 / 3ep 0.6581 -- 2 epochs is the confirmed optimum under the fuzzy-gate corpus. NUM_EPOCHS restored to 2 (repo and server back in the optimal state). See logs/V3_TRAINING_FAILURES.md V3 Iteration 3.

provenance.note: No source changes committed for this iteration: NUM_EPOCHS=1 was applied as a temporary server-side edit for the run and restored to 2 immediately after (2 epochs confirmed optimal by the sweep). Training via src/02_train_distill.py; evals via src/08_hybrid_eval.py (72-rec), src/07_failure_eval.py, src/08_hybrid_eval.py (288-rec) over SSH + nohup.

training_configuration.total_training_steps_comparison: 1346 (single epoch of 1346 steps) vs. iter 2's 2692 (2 x 1346) and iter 1's 3237 (3 x 1079). Lowest step count tested; completes the 1/2/3-epoch sweep under the fuzzy-gate corpus.

per_epoch_loss.note: epoch-1 avg loss 0.0489 (mean over 1346 logged steps, from logs/02_train_distill_v3iter3.log) -- essentially identical to iter 2's epoch-1 0.0486, as expected since the first epoch is recipe-identical.

training_performance.checkpoint_sha256_note: sha256 of models/distilled_minicpm5_1b_v2_amd/model.safetensors computed on amd-training-2 after training completed

evaluation_metrics_72record_eval.comparison_to_iteration_15: field F1 0.6581 (it1, 3ep) -> 0.6745 (it2, 2ep) -> 0.6597 (this run, 1ep): one epoch under the fuzzy-gate corpus underfits -- it ties iter 1's 3-epoch result and loses to iter 2 by -0.0148. Sweep optimum confirmed at 2 epochs. missing_field share rose back to 57.0% (196/344) from iter 2's 52.3% (196/375) and total failure count fell to 344; schema_validity improved to 0.9583 (vs iter 2's 0.8889) but field F1 regressed.

evaluation_metrics_288record_eval.note: Larger eval set corroborates the 72-record result: field F1 0.6524, schema validity 0.9410, missing_field_rate 0.1577 -- below iter 2's 288-rec F1 0.6742.

final_artifacts.checkpoint_used_for_huggingface_upload_n: field F1 0.6597 (72-rec) is below iter 2's 0.6745 and the published V2/iter-15 checkpoint (0.6827). One-epoch model underfits; 2 epochs remains the confirmed optimum. Not a candidate for HF upload; missing_field remains the dominant failure class.
